text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Ingress queue imbalance causing intermittent 502s for hosted inference (us-east). Affected ~1-3% of requests since 14:00 UTC. Mitigation in progress — routing new traffic away from overloaded hosts. Runbook: https://status.redwood.ai/runbooks/ingress-queue-smoothing

mike.s: seeing a sharp 502 spike on prod-ingress-1, tail latency jumped. Traces point to queue churn between router and inference pool.

linda.ops: acknowledged. starting to cordon & drain node-group-3 to stop new sessions hitting the suspected hosts (14:06 UTC).

alex.p: is autoscaler involved here or just unlucky bin-packing? any obvious config flapped?

mike.s: autoscaler did add pods but a prewarm init step is OOMing on a subset of nodes — pods go CrashLoopBackOff, making a feedback loop. reproduces on canary with the same image.

linda.ops: disabling prewarm on the current rollout, reverting image to v2.1.2 where prewarm is off. deploying now.

jamie.support: prepping a customer note. Draft: "We observed intermittent 502s affecting a small subset of hosted requests in us-east; mitigation underway." LMK if wording needs to be stronger.

mike.s: hotfix pushed at 14:12 UTC (ingress-service:v2.1.3 -> v2.1.2), traffic rerouted; error rate trending down to ~0.6%. KV-cache warming in progress.

linda.ops: drain completed on node-group-3, no new CrashLoopBackOffs after rollback. continuing to monitor for ~30m.

eva.pm: ETA for full recovery? customers asking.

mike.s: estimating 20-30m for steady-state (cache warm + half-life on in-flight requests). will update when stable <0.5% for 5m.

incident-bot: [UPDATE] Error rate back to baseline (~0.2%) at 14:20 UTC. Mitigation summary: disabled prewarm for current ingress rollout, drained affected nodes, rolled back problematic image. No customer data loss. Postmortem scheduled: 2026-03-24 16:00 UTC in #incidents-postmortems. Incident page: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/2335001234

jamie.support: status page updated and customer-facing note published. Link shared in #customer-updates.

eva.pm: thanks everyone — can ops/eng capture timeline and RCA in the postmortem doc? I'll lead stakeholder comms after that. :raised_hands:
